how_to_read_this: One row per user-facing promise. A feature is only VERIFIED_LIVE when the live product path reaches it AND evidence shows it ran. Seeded 2026-09-10 with ONLY what was actually proven; everything not listed is NOT_YET_AUDITED by definition, which is the honest backlog rather than a silent assumption. Enforced by tools/feature-truth-lint.mjs.

labels.VERIFIED_REAL_LIVE: Proven with real production agency/client usage.
labels.LIVE_DEMO_VERIFIED: Full path proven end-to-end in the live environment with demo/test data. Pilot-ready when also regression-guarded, safe against unapproved sends, and the UI matches the engine.
labels.MECHANISM_PROVEN: The underlying worker/cron/send path has real evidence, but the full product promise is not proven.
labels.PARTIAL_UNPROVEN: Pieces exist; the full promise is not proven.
labels.EXISTS_BUT_NOT_WIRED: Built, possibly 'active', but no live caller reaches it.
labels.FALSE_UI_CLAIM: The UI says or implies something untrue. Must be fixed, never parked.
labels.NOT_LIVE_COMING_LATER: Intentionally not live; the UI says so.
labels.NOT_YET_AUDITED: Nobody has walked the eight questions. Never present as working. Backlog, not a CI failure.

features.promise: When an agent approves a reply, it is sent on WhatsApp or email.
features.trigger_expected: approve_dashboard_task -> send_queue -> pg_cron send-queue-due-tick -> 3C Send-Pusher -> whatsapp-send-execute / Resend
features.trigger_actual: Exactly that. pg_cron 'send-queue-due-tick' runs every minute and POSTs the Send-Pusher wake with the vault secret.
evidence: pg_cron send-queue-due-tick: 10,897 runs, 0 failures, last run 2026-09-10
3C Send-Pusher: 27 executions, all webhook mode, most recent 2026-08-31
send_queue: 37 delivered rows; provider_audit_log 78 rows; 38 lead_events of type followup_sent
features.failure_behaviour: sweep_stuck_send_jobs (pg_cron, every 5 min) raises operator-visible send_issue dashboard tasks for stuck, expired and failed rows.
features.ui_guard: NONE YET — the approve action does not tell an agent whether the send actually left the building; they learn from the conversation view.
features.regression_guard: MISSING — no automated test asserts the pg_cron -> wake -> Send-Pusher -> provider chain. Recorded as a finding.
features.note: Downgraded from VERIFIED_LIVE on 2026-09-10 by tools/feature-truth-lint.mjs, which refused a VERIFIED_LIVE row whose regression guard was only PARTIAL. The MECHANISM is proven (10,897 cron runs 0 failures; 27 Send-Pusher executions; 37 delivered send_queue rows), but it has only ever run in demo conditions for one demo agency, last on 2026-08-31, and nothing automated would notice if the chain broke. Proven-by-history is not proven-under-real-use.
features.proven_issue: The cron→wake→Send-Pusher→provider chain has real evidence but no automated regression test, and has only run with demo data.
features.product_impact: If the chain broke, approved replies would stop leaving the building and nothing automated would notice.
features.immediate_truth_fix: None needed — the UI does not overclaim here.
features.permanent_product_fix: Add a regression test asserting the chain; then re-label.

features.promise: A buyer messages on WhatsApp and Amanda answers.
features.trigger_expected: Twilio -> twilio-whatsapp-inbound EF -> amanda_inbound_queue -> outbox worker -> send_queue
features.trigger_actual: That path is real and has run, but only for one demo agency under demo conditions.
evidence: 26 amanda_engine send_queue rows delivered 2026-08-27..31
15 inbound conversation_messages in all of production history, one agency
0 orphans: every inbound message has a queue row
features.failure_behaviour: A known P1 gap: if the Edge Function dies between storing the message and enqueuing it, a redelivery is treated as a duplicate and the enqueue is skipped. Nothing reconciles the two tables. Latent, never yet triggered.
features.ui_guard: NONE YET — the inbox does not distinguish 'Amanda answered' from 'Amanda never got the turn'.
features.regression_guard: MISSING — no test covers the duplicate_ignored path. Recorded in the parking lot as P1.
features.proven_issue: Proven end-to-end in the live environment with demo data (26 delivered engine replies). A latent P1 remains: a redelivered webhook can skip the Amanda enqueue, and nothing reconciles it.
features.product_impact: The core customer path works in demo conditions. The P1 would silently lose a lead's turn.
features.immediate_truth_fix: None — the UI does not overclaim; but it cannot distinguish 'Amanda answered' from 'Amanda never got the turn'.
features.permanent_product_fix: Fix the duplicate_ignored gate + add a reconciliation sweep (parking lot P1).

pilot_ready_rule: Pilot readiness does NOT require VERIFIED_REAL_LIVE — there is no real agency traffic yet. A feature is pilot-ready when it is at least LIVE_DEMO_VERIFIED, the full path is proven in the live environment with test/demo data, it is regression-guarded, it cannot send for real without approval, and the UI truth matches the engine.
closing_rule: Christian, 2026-09-11: a caption, warning or not-live label is an IMMEDIATE TRUTH FIX, never the permanent fix. An issue closes only when (A) the feature works end-to-end and is verified, (B) it is intentionally retired and the product promise removed, or (C) it is explicitly not part of AIVENA now — NOT_LIVE_COMING_LATER with an owner and a revisit status.
